name: io.github.junyeong-nero/kitsune
title: Kitsune
description: Let your coding agent use the Firefox, Zen, or LibreWolf browser you already have open.

environmentVariables.name: KITSUNE_SCRIPTING
environmentVariables.description: 1 (default): the minimal tool list with browser_run_python (trusted local Python, not a sandbox); 0: the legacy direct tool list

environmentVariables.name: KITSUNE_ASK_BEFORE_ACT
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hold submits, payment pages, JavaScript, and cookie access until the call is confirmed
